title: Subgame Perfect Uniform Folk Theorem
body_html:
Subgame Perfect Uniform Folk Theorem

For standard repeated games, requiring subgame perfection does not change the uniform folk-theorem payoff set: $$ E_\infty' = E_\infty = E. $$

MFoGT obtains this by replacing eternal punishment with finite punishment phases after which play restarts on the main path.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 8, Thm. 8.5.5] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Perfect folk theorem for uniform equilibria.
